{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk blouse, relaxed fit, knee-length hem, midnight blue (#001f3f), woven satin.
Wool-blend midi skirt, A-line cut with subtle pleats, calf length, charcoal gray (#36454F), heavy wool flannel.
Textured blazer, single-breasted with notch lapels, hip length, deep forest green (#2E4618), boucle knit.
Leather ankle boots, pointed toe with a 4 cm stiletto heel, shaft height just above the ankle, espresso brown (#3B2F2F), smooth calfskin.
This outfit strikes the perfect balance between comfort and elegance for an evening date in rainy autumn weather. The structured blazer and wool skirt provide essential warmth against the cold while maintaining a neat, sophisticated silhouette suitable for both the movie theater and dinner. Rich, dark colors like midnight blue and forest green evoke a romantic mood that stands out under artificial lighting without being overpowering. The sleek ankle boots ensure she stays dry and confident on potentially wet surfaces while elevating the entire look from casual streetwear to polished evening wear."}
